scope: Tracked and non-ignored repository source files; excludes vendor trees, local generated reports/binaries, and auth/session data. Public sample reports are explicitly included.
limitations: Static import/module references can occur in documentation, types or tests; edges do not prove runtime invocation.
No dynamic imports, resolved Elixir short aliases/call graph, or dependency internals are exhaustively analyzed.
The standard Pipeline does not invoke Investigation; no edge asserts that it does.
The generated graph and index exclude themselves to avoid recursive hashes.

exports: REPO, ASSETS, packageRoot, platformKey, assetName, binaryPath, driverPath, downloadUrl
createTelemetry, summarizeReport, sanitize, configPath, enable, disable, status, validHost, validKey, validUuid, UUID

edges.relation: renders standalone HTML with evidence and local comparison
focused snapshot via Driver; explicit invocation
